slides.title: An americano is not a lungo
slides.subtitle: They look alike. The water takes a different route.

slides.myth: An americano and a lungo are the same drink.
slides.truth: They look alike, but they're made differently. In a lungo, the extra water runs through the coffee. In an americano, it's added afterward.

left.label: Lungo
points: Extra water is part of the brew

slides.title: Why the taste changes
slides.body: Coffee's flavor components dissolve at different rates. Running more water through the grounds changes what ends up in your cup. Adding water afterward only thins what's already there.

slides.label: At home
slides.body: Want an americano? Pull your usual shot, then add hot water. Letting the shot run longer gives you a lungo instead.

slides.title: Same look, different route for the water
slides.body: Lungo: extra water through the coffee. Americano: extra water added after the shot.
